LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.label: 四时飞花
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.description: 春城无处不飞花，寒食东风御柳斜。
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMandate.completionEffec: 飞花令【绝】——强化所有三个飞花令技能的效果，附加额外的异常状态积累
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.label: 涓流之韵
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.description: 憋不出来了，总之是一句简介
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_DivineFortune.completionEffec: 刚柔并济——护盾受到高额伤害时触发额外保护，单次护盾受伤最高不会超过20点
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerDance.label: 起舞之韵
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerDance.description: “五陵年少争缠头，一曲红绡不知数”
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMastery.label: 百花玉音
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tree_FlowerMastery.description: 静心明过方可习得的花之真传
